easy: Without planning or getting ready first.

ex.en: She spoke spontaneously, without any notes.
ex.ko: 그녀는 메모 없이 즉흥적으로 말했다.

easy: Cooked with the hot gas that rises from boiling water.

ex.en: We ate steamed dumplings for dinner.
ex.ko: 우리는 저녁으로 찐 만두를 먹었다.

easy: A very big fish with bony plates on its back. It lives in rivers and seas.

ex.en: The sturgeon was as long as a canoe.
ex.ko: 그 철갑상어는 카누만큼 길었다.

easy: A paper from a court that orders a person to come and tell what they know.

ex.en: The judge sent a subpoena to my neighbor.
ex.ko: 판사가 우리 이웃에게 소환장을 보냈다.

easy: To order a person to come to court by sending a paper.

ex.en: The court subpoenaed the witness.
ex.ko: 법원은 증인에게 소환장을 보냈다.

easy: A person who comes from Taiwan, an island country in Asia.

ex.en: My friend is Taiwanese, and she makes great noodles.
ex.ko: 내 친구는 대만 사람인데 국수를 아주 잘 만든다.

easy: About the words in a piece of writing.

ex.en: The teacher asked us to find textual proof in the story.
ex.ko: 선생님은 이야기 본문에서 근거를 찾으라고 하셨다.

easy: Not changed by something.

ex.en: Our picnic was unaffected by the rain.
ex.ko: 우리 소풍은 비의 영향을 받지 않았다.

easy: So clearly true that nobody can say it is false.

ex.en: It is undeniable that our dog loves bones.
ex.ko: 우리 개가 뼈다귀를 좋아하는 것은 부인할 수 없다.

easy: In or toward the northern part of a state.

ex.en: We drove upstate to see the fall leaves.
ex.ko: 우리는 단풍을 보러 주 북부로 차를 타고 갔다.

easy: Watching carefully so you notice any danger.

ex.en: The vigilant dog barked when a stranger came near.
ex.ko: 경계심 강한 개가 낯선 사람이 다가오자 짖었다.

easy: A flat metal ring that fits under a nut or bolt to stop leaks.

ex.en: Dad put a washer on the pipe to stop the drip.
ex.ko: 아빠는 물이 새지 않게 파이프에 와셔를 끼우셨다.

easy: The string in a candle or lamp that burns.

ex.en: I lit the wick of the birthday candle.
ex.ko: 나는 생일 초의 심지에 불을 붙였다.

easy: Helpful, because it gives you a better chance.

ex.en: Being tall is advantageous in basketball.
ex.ko: 농구에서는 키가 큰 것이 유리하다.

easy: Floating on top of water.

ex.en: The little boat stayed afloat on the lake.
ex.ko: 작은 배가 호수 위에 떠 있었다.

easy: The ability to move fast and easily.

ex.en: The cat jumped with great agility.
ex.ko: 고양이가 아주 민첩하게 뛰어올랐다.

easy: The upset feeling you get when something bothers you again and again.

ex.en: My brother's loud singing is a big annoyance.
ex.ko: 동생의 시끄러운 노래는 정말 짜증스럽다.

easy: Riding in a boat for fun.

ex.en: We went boating on the lake last summer.
ex.ko: 우리는 지난여름 호수에서 보트를 탔다.

easy: Bent in a curve, like a rainbow.

ex.en: The old branch was bowed under the heavy snow.
ex.ko: 오래된 나뭇가지가 무거운 눈 때문에 휘어 있었다.

easy: The place where baseball pitchers practice throwing before they play.

ex.en: The relief pitcher warmed up in the bullpen.
ex.ko: 구원투수가 불펜에서 몸을 풀었다.

easy: Having to do with dogs and animals like dogs, such as wolves.

ex.en: Wolves and dogs are both canine animals.
ex.ko: 늑대와 개는 둘 다 개과 동물이다.

easy: Being the reason that something happens.

ex.en: We found a causal link between sleep and good grades.
ex.ko: 우리는 잠과 좋은 성적 사이의 인과 관계를 찾았다.

easy: In or near the middle.

ex.en: Our school is centrally located in town.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 마을 중심에 있다.

easy: A person who leads the crowd in cheering at a game.

ex.en: The cheerleader waved her pom-poms at the football game.
ex.ko: 치어리더가 풋볼 경기에서 응원용 술을 흔들었다.

easy: A strong building where people could stay safe in a fight.

ex.en: The villagers hid in the citadel on top of the hill.
ex.ko: 마을 사람들은 언덕 위 성채에 숨었다.

easy: When a strong country takes over another land and uses its riches.

ex.en: Many countries fought to end colonialism.
ex.ko: 많은 나라가 식민주의를 끝내기 위해 싸웠다.

easy: Willing to give up a little to settle an argument.

ex.en: She was compromising, so we found a plan we both liked.
ex.ko: 그녀가 타협적이어서 우리 둘 다 마음에 드는 계획을 찾았다.

easy: The panel in front of the driver with dials and buttons.

ex.en: The light on the dashboard told us the car needed gas.
ex.ko: 계기판의 불빛이 차에 기름이 필요하다고 알려 줬다.

easy: Very evil, like a monster in a scary story.

ex.en: The movie villain had a demonic laugh.
ex.ko: 영화 속 악당은 악마 같은 웃음소리를 냈다.

easy: Very, very angry.

ex.en: The enraged bull ran across the field.
ex.ko: 격분한 황소가 들판을 가로질러 달렸다.

easy: Slowly worn away by water, wind, or ice.

ex.en: The eroded cliff by the sea was full of cracks.
ex.ko: 바다 옆 침식된 절벽은 갈라진 틈투성이였다.

easy: A funny play with silly things that could never really happen.

ex.en: The school play was a farce, and everyone laughed.
ex.ko: 학교 연극은 익살극이어서 모두가 웃었다.

easy: Moving smoothly along a surface.

ex.en: The skater's glide across the ice was smooth.
ex.ko: 스케이트 선수는 얼음 위를 부드럽게 활주했다.

easy: To feel very sad because someone died or something was lost.

ex.en: We grieved when our old dog died.
ex.ko: 우리는 늙은 개가 죽었을 때 슬퍼했다.

easy: To make someone feel very sad.

ex.en: It grieves Mom when we fight.
ex.ko: 우리가 싸우면 엄마는 마음 아파하신다.

easy: The way your hair is cut and arranged.

ex.en: I got a new hairstyle for picture day.
ex.ko: 나는 사진 찍는 날을 위해 새 머리 모양을 했다.

easy: Written with a pen or pencil, not typed.

ex.en: Grandma sent me a handwritten letter.
ex.ko: 할머니가 손으로 쓴 편지를 보내 주셨다.

easy: Not kind and not caring about how others feel.

ex.en: It was heartless to laugh at his mistake.
ex.ko: 그의 실수를 비웃는 것은 매정한 일이었다.

easy: A person who gives information.

ex.en: The detective talked to an informant about the missing bike.
ex.ko: 탐정은 정보 제공자에게 잃어버린 자전거에 대해 물었다.

easy: To live in a place.

ex.en: Penguins inhabit the cold lands near the South Pole.
ex.ko: 펭귄은 남극 근처의 추운 땅에 산다.

easy: Happening in the time between two events.

ex.en: We grew a lot in the intervening years.
ex.ko: 그 사이 몇 해 동안 우리는 많이 자랐다.

easy: Full of happiness.

ex.en: The joyous kids cheered on the last day of school.
ex.ko: 신이 난 아이들이 학기 마지막 날 환호했다.

easy: A fruit with fuzzy brown skin and green juicy inside.

ex.en: I put kiwi slices in my yogurt.
ex.ko: 나는 요거트에 키위 조각을 넣었다.

easy: A very long, fancy car.

ex.en: They rode a white limo to the dance.
ex.ko: 그들은 흰색 리무진을 타고 무도회에 갔다.

easy: The time of day when people eat lunch.

ex.en: We play tag outside at lunchtime.
ex.ko: 우리는 점심시간에 밖에서 술래잡기를 한다.

easy: The long thick hair on the neck of a horse or lion.

ex.en: The lion shook his big mane.
ex.ko: 사자가 커다란 갈기를 흔들었다.

easy: Makeup that makes eyelashes look dark and thick.

ex.en: Mom put mascara on her eyelashes.
ex.ko: 엄마는 속눈썹에 마스카라를 발랐다.

easy: Helping two people meet so they might get married.

ex.en: Grandma loved matchmaking and introduced many couples.
ex.ko: 할머니는 중매를 좋아해서 많은 사람을 소개해 주셨다.

easy: A sickness with a fever and red spots on the skin.

ex.en: A shot can keep you from getting measles.
ex.ko: 예방 주사를 맞으면 홍역에 걸리지 않는다.

easy: Having to do with tiny living things you cannot see.

ex.en: Microbial life fills a drop of pond water.
ex.ko: 연못물 한 방울에도 미생물이 가득하다.

easy: A very bad headache that can come back again and again.

ex.en: My aunt has a migraine and must rest in a dark room.
ex.ko: 이모는 편두통이 있어서 어두운 방에서 쉬어야 한다.

easy: Turned into liquid by great heat.

ex.en: Molten lava flowed down the volcano.
ex.ko: 녹은 용암이 화산 아래로 흘러내렸다.

easy: Not taking care of what you should do.

ex.en: The negligent boy forgot to feed the fish.
ex.ko: 부주의한 소년이 물고기 밥 주는 것을 잊었다.

easy: To make something work as well as it possibly can.

ex.en: We optimize recess by picking our games first.
ex.ko: 우리는 놀이를 미리 정해서 쉬는 시간을 최대한 활용한다.

easy: In a way that shows very strong feeling.

ex.en: She sang passionately on the school stage.
ex.ko: 그녀는 학교 무대에서 열정적으로 노래했다.

easy: Getting someone to agree or do something by giving good reasons.

ex.en: After lots of persuasion, Dad let us get a puppy.
ex.ko: 많은 설득 끝에 아빠가 강아지를 키우게 해 주셨다.

easy: Cloth with crossing stripes that make a pattern.

ex.en: He wore a red plaid shirt.
ex.ko: 그는 빨간 격자무늬 셔츠를 입었다.

easy: Playing a recording again so you can hear or see it.

ex.en: We watched the playback of our soccer game.
ex.ko: 우리는 축구 경기 녹화 영상을 다시 재생해서 봤다.

easy: A soft, fuzzy cloth.

ex.en: My teddy bear is made of plush.
ex.ko: 내 곰 인형은 플러시 천으로 만들어졌다.

easy: Perfectly clean, like nobody has touched it.

ex.en: We hiked to a pristine lake in the mountains.
ex.ko: 우리는 산속의 깨끗한 호수까지 걸어갔다.

easy: Very clean and like new.

ex.en: My new sneakers looked pristine on the first day.
ex.ko: 내 새 운동화는 첫날 새것처럼 깨끗해 보였다.

easy: Spinning blades that push a boat or plane forward.

ex.en: The propeller on the toy plane spun fast.
ex.ko: 장난감 비행기의 프로펠러가 빠르게 돌았다.

easy: A very loud noise that bothers people.

ex.en: The kids made a racket in the hallway.
ex.ko: 아이들이 복도에서 소란을 피웠다.

easy: In a way that deals with how things really are.

ex.en: Realistically, we cannot finish before dinner.
ex.ko: 현실적으로 저녁 전에는 끝낼 수 없다.

easy: In a way that looks just like the real thing.

ex.en: The artist drew the horse realistically.
ex.ko: 그 화가는 말을 사실적으로 그렸다.

easy: Changing how something is set up so it works in a new way.

ex.en: Our teacher did a reorganization of the classroom desks.
ex.ko: 선생님은 교실 책상 배치를 새로 바꾸셨다.

easy: Turned around in a circle.

ex.en: I rotated the globe until I found Korea.
ex.ko: 나는 한국이 보일 때까지 지구본을 돌렸다.

easy: Not going straight, but taking a longer way.

ex.en: We took a roundabout road to Grandpa's house.
ex.ko: 우리는 할아버지 댁에 돌아가는 길로 갔다.

easy: Salty water that doctors use to clean or help the body.

ex.en: The nurse rinsed my eye with saline.
ex.ko: 간호사가 식염수로 내 눈을 씻어 주었다.

easy: Making big boats and ships.

ex.en: Korea is famous for shipbuilding.
ex.ko: 한국은 조선업으로 유명하다.

easy: Filled with smoke.

ex.en: The campfire made the air smoky.
ex.ko: 모닥불 때문에 공기가 연기로 자욱했다.

easy: Tasting like food that was cooked over smoke.

ex.en: I like the smoky taste of grilled sausage.
ex.ko: 나는 구운 소시지의 훈제 맛이 좋다.

easy: A playing card with a black shape like a pointy leaf.

ex.en: I drew the ace of spades.
ex.ko: 나는 스페이드 에이스를 뽑았다.

easy: A tool with a flat blade for digging.

ex.en: Dad used a spade to dig a hole for the tree.
ex.ko: 아빠는 삽으로 나무를 심을 구덩이를 파셨다.

easy: Measuring land so that maps can be made.

ex.en: Surveying shows where a road should go.
ex.ko: 측량을 하면 길을 어디로 내야 할지 알 수 있다.

easy: A kitchen machine that makes bread warm and crispy.

ex.en: The toaster popped up my bread.
ex.ko: 토스터에서 내 빵이 튀어 올랐다.

easy: Three times as much.

ex.en: I got treble the stickers my sister got.
ex.ko: 나는 언니가 받은 스티커의 세 배를 받았다.

easy: A kind of light from the sun that our eyes cannot see. It can burn skin.

ex.en: Sunscreen blocks ultraviolet rays.
ex.ko: 자외선 차단제는 자외선을 막아 준다.

easy: Fair, not picking one side.

ex.en: A good referee must be unbiased.
ex.ko: 좋은 심판은 공정해야 한다.

easy: Fair, with no favorite side.

ex.en: The reporter told an unbiased story about both teams.
ex.ko: 기자는 두 팀에 대해 공정하게 이야기를 전했다.

easy: The player or team that most people think will lose.

ex.en: Our small team was the underdog, but we won.
ex.ko: 우리 작은 팀은 약팀이었지만 이겼다.

easy: Not showing thanks when someone is kind to you.

ex.en: It is rude to be ungrateful for a gift.
ex.ko: 선물에 감사할 줄 모르는 것은 무례하다.

easy: Not given any medicine or care from a doctor.

ex.en: An untreated cut can get infected.
ex.ko: 치료하지 않은 상처는 감염될 수 있다.

easy: Not changed or coated with chemicals.

ex.en: This untreated wood is plain and rough.
ex.ko: 이 처리되지 않은 나무는 밋밋하고 거칠다.

easy: Breaking or ruining things that belong to other people on purpose.

ex.en: Painting on the school wall is vandalism.
ex.ko: 학교 벽에 낙서하는 것은 기물 파손이다.

easy: A person who takes a long trip, often by ship.

ex.en: The voyager sailed across the ocean.
ex.ko: 그 항해자는 바다를 건넜다.

easy: A place where two pieces of metal are joined together by heat.

ex.en: The weld held the two metal bars together.
ex.ko: 용접 부분이 두 금속 막대를 붙잡고 있었다.

easy: A make-believe monster that changes from a person into a wolf.

ex.en: The werewolf howled at the full moon in the story.
ex.ko: 이야기 속 늑대인간은 보름달을 보고 울부짖었다.

easy: Showing that you have seen or noticed someone.

ex.en: He gave a nod as an acknowledgment of my wave.
ex.ko: 그는 내가 손을 흔들자 고개를 끄덕여 알은체했다.

easy: Loved very, very much.

ex.en: The adored puppy slept on a soft pillow.
ex.ko: 큰 사랑을 받는 강아지가 푹신한 베개에서 잤다.

easy: Something you do to fix a wrong you did.

ex.en: I made amends by helping clean up my mess.
ex.ko: 나는 내가 어지른 것을 치우며 잘못을 만회했다.

easy: A guess about how much or how many, close but not exact.

ex.en: My approximation was ten minutes, but it took twelve.
ex.ko: 내가 어림잡은 시간은 10분이었는데 12분이 걸렸다.

easy: Having a strong, nice smell.

ex.en: The aromatic cookies filled the kitchen with a sweet smell.
ex.ko: 향기로운 쿠키가 부엌을 달콤한 냄새로 가득 채웠다.

easy: Of a fancy style of art, buildings, and music from Europe long ago.

ex.en: We listened to baroque music in class.
ex.ko: 우리는 수업 시간에 바로크 음악을 들었다.

easy: Without being able to see.

ex.en: I reached blindly in the dark for the light switch.
ex.ko: 나는 어둠 속에서 앞이 안 보여 더듬어 전등 스위치를 찾았다.

easy: Without thinking first about whether it is a good idea.

ex.en: Don't follow the crowd blindly.
ex.ko: 무턱대고 남을 따라 하지 마라.
